definitions.explanation: Indicates that a package, order, or shipment has already been sent. Commonly seen in online shopping notifications, tracking pages, and business correspondence.

examples.japanese: ご{注文|ちゅうもん}の{商品|しょうひん}は{発送済|はっそうず}みです。
examples.english: Your ordered item has been shipped.

examples.japanese: ステータスが「{発送済|はっそうず}み」に{変|か}わった。
{発送済|はっそうず}みの{荷物|にもつ}は、{通常|つうじょう}{二|ふつ}{日|か}から{三|みっ}{日|か}で{届|とど}きます。
examples.english: Shipped packages typically arrive within two to three days.

notes:
FORMS:
Formed from {発送|はっそう} (shipping, dispatch) + {済|ず}み (completed, done). The suffix ～{済|ず}み attaches to action nouns to indicate the action has been completed.

RELATED WORDS:
- {配達済|はいたつず}み (delivered)
- {支払|しはら}い{済|ず}み (paid)
- {確認済|かくにんず}み (confirmed)
- {手続|てつづ}き{済|ず}み (processed)

USAGE:
Often appears on tracking pages, email notifications, and order status screens. Can function as a noun or a pre-noun modifier with の.
